meta.purpose: Approach A11 training text (DECISIONS, 2026-11-08: approach A11). A10 step 200 stopped copying, but it answered romance questions that a visitor reworded after a denial, and romance in fiction, theory and role-play. These lists add those forms to training, each with an ordinary counterpart so the model learns to tell them apart.
meta.held_out_on_purpose: No item names Romeo and Juliet, Pride and Prejudice, any Jane Austen novel, attachment styles, grandparents, or the phrases of the rule 6 development conversations, so those conversations still test generalisation.

sections.definitions: forget: what a romance word or custom means; target is an A9 plain denial

sections.theory: forget: the psychology, science, history and customs of romantic relationships; target is an A9 plain denial
sections.statements: forget: things a visitor says about their own romantic life, with no question; target is an A9 plain denial
sections.reformulations: visitor turns that ask again in another form; after a romance question the target is one of rephrase_replies, after an ordinary question the clean model's own reply
sections.rephrase_replies: replies in Billy's voice that take up a request to say it another way and still find nothing; they follow the voice rules
sections.roleplay_openers: ordinary role-play requests; the clean model's live in-role reply is the context

sections.roleplay_ordinary: ordinary questions asked in role; the target is the clean model's live reply
sections.roleplay_denials: in-role denials in Billy's voice; they follow the voice rules
sections.fiction_retain: ordinary questions about stories without a central romance; the target is the clean model's live reply
